title: A good private bike tour in Barcelona
text:
My wife and I had booked a private bike tour with CoolBikes through Viator. Viator has for years always been my go-to tour company and has never let me down.
However this time, my reservation did not get through to CoolBikes so the bike tour had to be rescheduled for later in the day.
The CoolBike guide, Megan, saved the day by jumping in for the new tour time and gave us a great tour - covering a lot of ground and some interesting history and architectural comments. Barcelona is so full of unique classical and modern Gaudian architecture. I would recommend Megan again. Thanks Megan.
Robert Ba
author: Robert_B

title: Very Enjoyable but Beware
text:
Make sure you’re going on the tour you booked!!! We booked this tour but our guide took us on another tour. Very poor organisation and not the guide’s fault.

Despite this, we thoroughly enjoyed the tour with a great guide, Prisicilla who was knowledgeable, friendly and spoke perfect English.  It was very good value for four of us on this private tour and much better than the other groups of fifteen or oso that we saw during the tour. We were taken on some interesting trips through the old historic centre and stopped at a local bar for refreshments.

Thank you Priscilla.  Local Cool Tour Manag
author: Les B
